        return eval(expression)

    max_value = float('-inf')
    n = len(s)
    
    for i in range(1, n - 1, 2):

        new_expression = f"({left_part}){s[i]}({right_part})"
        value = evaluate(new_expression)
        if value > max_value:
            max_value = value
    
    return max_value

import sys

def max_expression_value(s):
    n = len(s)
    dp_max = [[0] * n for _ in range(n)]
    dp_min = [[0] * n for _ in range(n)]
    
    # Initialize the diagonal with single digit values
    for i in range(0, n, 2):
        dp_max[i][i] = int(s[i])
        dp_min[i][i] = int(s[i])
    
    # Fill the DP tables
    for length in range(3, n + 1, 2):  # length of the segment
        for i in range(0, n - length + 1, 2):
            j = i + length - 1
            for k in range(i + 1, j, 2):
                op = s[k]
                if op == '+':
                    dp_max[i][j] = max(dp_max[i][j], dp_max[i][k-1] + dp_max[k+1][j], dp_min[i][k-1] + dp_min[k+1][j])
                    dp_min[i][j] = min(dp_min[i][j], dp_min[i][k-1] + dp_min[k+1][j], dp_max[i][k-1] + dp_max[k+1][j])
                elif op == '*':
                    dp_max[i][j] = max(dp_max[i][j], dp_max[i][k-1] * dp_max[k+1][j], dp_min[i][k-1] * dp_min[k+1][j], dp_max[i][k-1] * dp_min[k+1][j], dp_min[i][k-1] * dp_max[k+1][j])
                    dp_min[i][j] = min(dp_min[i][j], dp_min[i][k-1] * dp_min[k+1][j], dp_max[i][k-1] * dp_max[k+1][j], dp_max[i][k-1] * dp_min[k+1][j], dp_min[i][k-1] * dp_max[k+1][j])
    
    return dp_max[0][n-1]
